rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and matches the provided 3AA label, but it overstates image certainty with precise positional details and hatching/thinning observations that may not be clearly verifiable from a single image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, oocyte yield, endometrium, BMI, diagnosis, and semen parameters well, though calling this definite DOR/low responder is somewhat stronger than the data support.

Reasoning is logical and mostly well supported, with a coherent link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat speculative adjustments for unexplained infertility and alcohol effect magnitude.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with IVF practice, especially SET in a young patient with a good blastocyst; minor deviations include overemphasis on embryo banking and protocol changes from limited reserve data.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle modification, and contingency planning, though some future-cycle suggestions are somewhat generic and not tightly individualized.
